PUNJAB REVENUE AUTHORITY EMPLOYEES (APPOINTMENT AND
CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 2023.
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
10th August, 2023]
No.SO(TAX)5-55/2020,
dated 4-8-2023.----In exercise of
the powers conferred under section 33 of the Punjab Revenue Authority Act, 2012
(XLIII of 2012), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to make the following rules:
PART-I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short
title and commencement.- (1) These
rules may be cited as the Punjab Revenue Authority Employees (Appointment and
Conditions of Service) Rules, 2023.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.- (1) In the rules, unless the subject or context
requires otherwise:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Revenue Authority Act 2012 (XLIII of 2012);
(b) "Appointing
Authority" means an authority as reflected in column No. 3 of Schedule-I;
(c) "Commission"
means the Punjab Public Service Commission;
(d) "initial
appointment" means appointment made otherwise than by promotion or
transfer;
(e) "pay
and allowances" means the pay and allowances as given in Part-III;
(f) "permanent
post" means a post sanctioned without limit of time;
(g) "post"
means a post as reflected in column No. 2 of Schedule-I;
(h) "promotion
committee" means a committee as given in
Schedule-IV;
(i) "rules"
means the Punjab Revenue Authority Employees (Appointment and Conditions of
Service) Rules, 2023;
(j) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to the rules;
(k) "scrutiny
committee" means a committee as given in Scheduled-II;
(l) "selection
committee" means a committee as given in Scheduled-III;
(m) "service"
means the service of the Authority; and
(n) "temporary
post" means a post other than a permanent post;
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act.
PART-II
APPOINTMENTS AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE
3. Nomenclature,
terms and conditions of a post.-
The nomenclature of a post, appointing authority, its scale of pay, minimum
qualification and experience, method of recruitment, minimum and maximum age
limit and mode of appointment shall be such as given in Schedule-I.
4. Procedure
of initial appointment against a post.- (1) Initial appointment to a post shall be made by the Appointing
Authority on the recommendations of the Commission or selection committee, as
the case may be, after advertisement of the vacancies in at least two national
dailies, one in English and one in Urdu having wide circulation.
(2) Age
shall be reckoned as on the last date fixed for submission of application for
appointment.
(3) Age
relaxation, for appointment by initial recruitment, shall be admissible as per
policy of the Government.
(4) An
appointment shall be made from amongst the candidates domiciled in the Punjab.
(5) An
appointment, by initial recruitment, shall be made subject to production of a
medical fitness certificate of the appointee from the Government hospital.
(6) The
mode of initial appointment shall be either contract or regular as may be
decided by the Authority:
Provided
that in case of appointment on contract, the Contract Appointment Policy of the
Government shall mutatis mutandis apply.
(7) The
vacant posts shall be filled on open merit and quotas basis as per the
Government Policy.
(8) An
appointment by initial recruitment shall be subject to verification of
educational certificates and degrees of the candidate.
(9) No
person, not already in the service of the Authority, shall be appointed to a
post Unless he produces certificates of character from two responsible persons,
not being his relatives, who are well acquainted with his character and
antecedents and a certificate of character from the head of the academic
institution attended, where applicable.
(10) If,
at any stage after appointment, it is discovered that an appointee obtained
appointment on the basis of false or forged document or through deceit by any
means, the appointment shall be considered

shall be liable to refund all amounts received in consequence of
appointment in addition to such other actions as may be taken against him under
the law.
